messages:
tess (People Ops): Quick post-allhands thread for leftover Qs on reviews/leveling/promos/comp/benefits. Please keep Qs short; we'll assign owners. Key dates: calibration 2024-07-01 to 2024-07-07, manager confirmations due 2024-07-01, retro pay target 2024-08-01.

leo (IC): If I disagree with my manager on a level rec, can I share supporting examples directly to the calibration packet?

tess (People Ops): Yes — ask your manager to include peer evidence or link your examples in the packet. Peers can also submit written notes via the peer-evidence doc. If calibration still disagrees, there's a post-calibration appeal window.

nina (Eng Manager): Managers: include 2 clear impact examples for any upward rec. Bullet format is fine. Avoid subjective language.

adri (Finance): For retro pay timing: approved promos should appear on the 2024-08-01 payroll unless special cases are flagged to payroll earlier.

leo (IC): Is there an expedited path for counteroffers/market moves before calibration closes?

tess (People Ops): Yes — open a "comp-hot" case and mark urgent. Provide current offer, recommended comp, and retention risk. We triage fast for near-offer or critical retention cases.

peopleops-bot: Pinned -> /handbook/reviews/simple-rubric and /forms/comp-hot-case.

tom (CTO): One ask: engineering leads, please standardize the artifact types you attach (PRs, perf metrics, customer impact) so calibration sees consistent signals.

tess (People Ops): We'll draft a one-page artifact checklist and post in the handbook + #announcements by tomorrow. Reply here if you want specific examples included.

leo (IC): Thanks — appreciate the clarifications.

tess (People Ops): Thanks all — closing notes: managers please block time for calibration reviews, and employees DM People Ops with private comp concerns.
